Emma Léné (born 15 July 1999) is a French female tennis player. Léné has a career-high WTA singles ranking of world No. 351 achieved on 14 October 2024. Doubles ranking of world No. 329 achieved on 21 October 2024. [ 1 ] Léné won her first major ITF title at the W50 in Saint-Palais-sur-Mer in the doubles draw, partnering Sarah Iliev .
